summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of P2 iteration (password reset, smart match, reports, WS chat). 12/12 pytest backend tests passed; all frontend flows verified end-to-end via Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~961 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth, users, exchanges, messages, reviews, admin, reports, matches, ws) for maintainability.
WebSocket close codes 4401/4403 are used (not HTTP 403 as the spec text mentions). Behavior is correct per WS RFC but review request text is imprecise; browser sees a WS close, not HTTP 403.
ConnectionManager.disconnect is called from inside broadcast while iterating on a copy — OK, but broadcast should also await ws.close on error paths for cleaner cleanup.
PATCH /api/admin/reports body uses raw dict instead of a Pydantic model — inconsistent with other endpoints; add ReportStatusUpdate model.
/api/matches loads up to 500 candidates in-memory and scores in Python — fine for MVP but move to Mongo aggregation with an index on skills_known/skills_wanted at scale.

forgot-password returns the reset link + token in the JSON response for demo purposes — flag: this is only acceptable because no email service is wired; document that this is a demo affordance and must be removed before production.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@skillswap.com / admin123 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Test users created dynamically via /register.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed TEST_ are created per run via /api/auth/register. One open report is left in DB from smart-match test flow (was dismissed by admin during UI test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_p2_features.py (pytest). WebSocket tests use `websockets` client via wss://learn-trade-54.preview.emergentagent.com/api/ws/chat/{ex}?token=<jwt>. Frontend tested via Playwright — verified: (1) forgot→reset→login flow, (2) smart-matches-section with 6 match cards including match-score-{id}=2★ and match-view-{id} for reciprocal skills user, (3) profile-report-btn→report-modal→report-reason→report-submit, (4) /chat/{exchangeId} shows chat-connection-status='Live' within 3s, (5) /admin reports tab with admin-tab-reports-count badge=2, admin-report-dismiss/action/delete-user-{id} all clickable, 'Report dismissed' toast shown. Admin login redirects to /admin (not /dashboard) — main agent flows relying on /dashboard redirect for admins should be aware.
